source_caption:
It took five years and 25 rewrites before David O. Russell finally got to direct this film. Sydney Pollack had initially told him that the story was tricky to balance because it mixed emotional, troubling, funny and romantic elements. Russell was especially drawn to the family relationships, as well as the story’s connection to his own son, Matthew, who has bipolar disorder and OCD.

The film went on to receive eight Oscar nominations, becoming the first film since Reds (1981) to be nominated in all four acting categories. It was also the first film since Million Dollar Baby (2004) to receive nominations for Best Picture, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress and Best Writing. Russell managed the same rare feat again the following year with American Hustle (2013).

🎥: Silver Linings Playbook (2012)
Dir. David O. Russell
